notes:
Drawing Colours is now more selective. A colour kept on a drawing no longer keeps a greyed colour of nearly the same hue: with light blue rainwater shown, grey-blue pipes beside it are shown in grey. A service's own lighter and darker shades still stay together.
A greyed colour, such as a grey-blue pipe, can now be chosen by right-click too: Show Only This Colour, Add This Colour and Remove This Colour work on it.
